category_title: Students with EBD experiencing behavioral outbursts and academic difficulties in science
scenario_title: Reading aloud and acquiring science vocabulary
minimal_context: Sam is in science class and is asked to read a passage from the textbook aloud to study new vocabulary words.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Sam, please read the next paragraph from the science textbook aloud so we can go over the new vocabulary words.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I like science, but I don't want to read the textbook. I'm not reading it out loud.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just do your best and read the first sentence for us.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks around the room defensively) No! The other students are just going to make fun of me. I know they are!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: No one is going to make fun of you. Go ahead and start reading.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Slams the textbook shut and yells at a nearby peer) What are you looking at?! I'm not reading this stupid book! Leave me alone!

TUTOR: Sam, please read the next paragraph from the science textbook aloud so we can go over the new vocabulary words.

task.content: Reading passages, studying vocabulary words, or memorizing facts
task.learning_goal: Acquisition and retention of core science knowledge

context.materials: Science textbook, graphic organizers, mnemonic devices (keyword, pegword, and letter mnemonics)

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When they read aloud from the text
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Outbursts in class and conflicts with peers
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: He always felt like the other students were making fun of him, and he would get very upset

behavior_patterns.condition: When asked to read aloud from the text in front of peers
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Had so many outbursts in science he spent his science class time in the resource room
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Felt like the other students were making fun of him, and he would get very upset
